name: trigon-customer-app
description: Subscriber app for Trigon Links. Signs in with user ID + CNIC and shows profile, payment history and complaints. Talks to the same Trigon Links server as the admin panel.

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleDebug
